chars.AZIZ: AZIZ: a Moroccan man in his mid-30s with short black hair and a trimmed black beard, wearing a beige canvas work jacket over a white t-shirt and dark blue jeans
chars.WIFE: WIFE: a young Moroccan woman about 25 with long dark brown hair in a low ponytail, no headscarf, wearing a mustard-yellow knit sweater and a long denim skirt
chars.MOM: MOM: a stern Moroccan woman in her 60s wearing a dark green djellaba and a white headscarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from an open bedroom doorway: WIFE sits on the edge of the bed in a modest Moroccan apartment bedroom in Fes, head-to-waist framing, face visible, crying with tears on her cheeks, hands clutching a tissue, caught by surprise. Soft afternoon light. 2D animated storybook style, no text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: AZIZ stands frozen in the bedroom doorway, worried and surprised, hand still on the door handle; in the background WIFE on the bed turns her tear-streaked face toward him. Moroccan apartment interior. 2D animated storybook style, no text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Happy memory: WIFE laughing brightly while cooking in a small Moroccan kitchen with blue zellige tiles, AZIZ beside her smiling and tasting from a spoon, warm golden light, cheerful mood. 2D animated storybook style, no text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot: WIFE quickly wiping her tears with the back of her hand and forcing an awkward smile, as if nothing happened, sitting on the bed. Moroccan bedroom. 2D animated storybook style, no text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: AZIZ sits next to WIFE on a Moroccan salon sofa with patterned cushions, asking her gently with concern; she avoids his eyes, looking down at her hands, clearly hiding something. 2D animated storybook style, no text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: WIFE stands at a window with the curtain half closed, looking out nervously at the street below, refusing to go out; AZIZ watches her from across the room holding car keys, puzzled. Moroccan apartment. 2D animated storybook style, no text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night, AZIZ sits alone at the kitchen table under a dim lamp, deep in suspicious thought, chin on his fist; behind him in the hallway MOM stands half in shadow watching him with a cold, satisfied look. Moroccan apartment. 2D animated storybook style, no text.
